note: A versioned scoring contract, separate from analysis/ghidra/models/approved-models.json -- that file is #158's own governance artifact (which model is approved to run in production, and the model-drift gates it must keep passing); this one is #159's own artifact (which cases this corpus's rubric covers, and a hash tying it to one exact rubric revision). Distinct because #159's corpus can grow (new cases, new architectures) on its own schedule without that being a #158 model-approval event, and #158 can requalify a model without touching this file. Checked by validate_manifest.py on every change.
